Sofia — thanks for sending these over and apologies for the delayed reply. Quick checklist before we can open the PO in our system: 

- Confirm the TIN/EIN printed on the W-8BEN-E matches the bank-letter legal name (Novacorp LLC).
- Confirm the signatory authority: our vendor setup requires either a corporate resolution naming the signer or a notarized signature page (we can accept a PDF notarization).
- If the W-8BEN-E is signed by someone other than the person listed on the bank letter, please provide an attestation explaining authority (or attach a corporate resolution).

If you can provide a scanned corporate resolution (or a notarized signature page) we'll route to Finance for bank verification and then create PO PO-000472. Monica and Laura are looped for procurement/ops confirmation.

Thanks — once we have those items I’ll coordinate PO creation and share the PO PDF and vendor ID.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Onboarding, Procurement
Redwood Inference
